filters.title: Filters

explanation.balanced: Street spaces receive up to 250 m preference over garage/P+R. Distances are straight-line.
explanation.distance: Nearest first. Equal distances use a stable source and identifier order.

filters.scope: Straight-line distance from the destination. Map and list show the same page. Freshness, restrictions and availability are not filters: missing data stays unknown. General garage occupancy does not indicate free accessible spaces.
filters.description: Refine parking locations near your destination.

controls.clusters: The number is the number of locations in the group. Green, yellow and orange indicate group size, not availability. Zoom in to explore locations.
controls.location: Your location. The circle indicates accuracy.
